task.description: Diagnose why the documented build command fails; do not implement a fix.
acceptance_criteria: The failure has a supported explanation and the project remains unchanged.

initial_state.summary: The documented build command fails reproducibly.

decisions.question: Can read-only reproduction and configuration inspection establish the cause?
decisions.basis: The requested diagnosis can be investigated safely without modifying project state.

evidence.description: The documented build command fails because the configured tool version rejects one option.
Running the same command without the unsupported option succeeds, supporting the version-mismatch explanation.

final_state.summary: The build failure is diagnosed; project files are unchanged.

report.summary: The documented command uses an option unsupported by the configured tool version.

verification.claim: The version mismatch explains the reproduced failure.

limitations: No fix was implemented or evaluated because the task requested diagnosis only.
